##### Project General Facts

The Morocco project boasts a breathtaking design aesthetic, featuring exquisite exteriors that embody the essence of refined living, with premium townhouses and villas that exemplify elegance and poise. These residences offer ample space, both indoors and outdoors, providing the perfect backdrop for creating lasting memories and a life of comfort, with beautiful layouts and state-of-the-art finishes, including intricate Zellij mosaic tilework and ornate carved wood. The townhouses and villas present an exceptional living experience, with lush living spaces that seamlessly transition into private gardens, striking a perfect balance between elegance and functionality.

The Morocco project features an array of amenities, including a serenity garden, a botanical garden, and a cactus garden inspired by the Jardin Majorelle in Marrakech, which provide a serene atmosphere for relaxation and entertainment. The emphasis on outdoor spaces and lush living areas creates a unique and desirable living environment, with an abundance of space for creating cherished memories, and amenities such as a play area, yoga area, and observation deck. The project also offers a variety of community facilities, including a concert stage, outdoor library, and arts and crafts studio, which cater to the needs of its residents.

The interior finishing of the Morocco project showcases modern finishing with high-quality materials, complemented by a timeless design that incorporates fresh, warm tones, and calm, relaxed atmospheres, which create a sense of serenity and tranquility. The homes feature exquisite interiors with a twist, blending customary regional elements with contemporary influences, resulting in a sophisticated aura of elegance and modern living. The kitchens are masterpieces of design, with an emphasis on functionality and elegance, and the bathrooms offer luxurious spaces for relaxation and rejuvenation.

##### Location description and benefits

Damac Lagoons is a beautiful and strategically located community, situated close to key arterial freeways such as Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, Emirates Road, and Al Khail Road. The location provides easy access to a range of amenities, including the Dubai Polo & Equestrian Club, Dubai Autodrome, and Dubai Miracle Garden, which are just a short drive away. Residents can also enjoy a range of shopping and dining options, with malls such as First Avenue Mall and City Centre Meaisem located nearby.

Damac Lagoons is surrounded by a range of prestigious schools, including Jebel Ali School, Fairgreen International School, and Global Indian International School, which offer a high-quality education to residents. The community is also close to a range of hospitals, including Aster Medical Centre, Mediclinic Parkview Hospital, and NMC Royal Hospital, which provide access to excellent medical care. The location is also convenient for travelers, with Al Maktoum International Airport located just a short drive away.

The Damac Lagoons community is situated opposite the DAMAC Hills community, and is hidden away along Hessa Street, providing a tranquil and serene atmosphere for residents. The location is also close to a range of hotels, including Park Inn by Radisson Dubai Motor City, Studio One Hotel, and Five Jumeirah Village Hotel, which offer a range of accommodation options for visitors. The community is well-connected to the rest of the city, with a range of public transportation options available, making it easy to get around.
